**Machine Learning Researcher**

**Company Overview**

GC Therapeutics is the first genome-wide cell landscape exploration company using an integrated synthetic biology and AI-driven platform for cell programming. Its patent-pending and proprietary pluripotent stem cell differentiation technology platform TFome™ was developed in Professor George Church’s lab, a pioneer in synthetic biology, and allows for the development of unique cell therapies with significantly streamlined manufacturing, improved cell quality, eﬃciency and speed. GC Therapeutics is based in Cambridge, MA. For additional information, please visit www.gc-tx.com.

**Job Purpose**

GC Therapeutics is seeking a highly motivated Machine Learning Researcher to join our computational biology team. In this role, you'll design, train, and benchmark virtual cell models that drive GC Therapeutics’
*in silico*
discovery platform. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in building and training deep learning models on complex multimodal datasets. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role, working closely with senior scientists and experimental biologists to translate model predictions into real therapeutic hypotheses. This is a full-time role, working on-site Monday through Friday.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Design and train deep learning architectures for modeling perturbation response and cellular state from multimodal training data.

* Build and maintain benchmarking pipelines to evaluate model performance and generalization.

* Process and integrate large-scale multimodal biological datasets (single-cell RNA-sequencing, perturbation, single-cell ATAC-seq, imaging) into training-ready pipelines.

* Collaborate with experimental biologists to define modeling tasks and validate predictions against wet-lab data.

**General Scientific Roles**

* Maintain coding best standards for documentation and reproducibility, summarize results, and create presentations for internal group meetings.

* Exemplify scientific curiosity and deep expertise with relevant literature and cutting-edge technologies to advance research directions.

* Work with other members of the research team and within GCTx to accomplish company goals.

**Qualifications**

***Essential Qualifications:***

* MS + 2-3 years of experience or PhD in computer science, machine learning, computational biology, or related field.

* Deep understanding of machine learning and deep learning approaches and their application to real world problems. Proven expertise in developing, implementing, and training state-of-the-art deep learning models (autoregressive models, transformers, LLMs, VAEs, or related architectures).

* Strong experience processing and analyzing large-scale multimodal datasets.

* Proficiency with Python (Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, sklearn) and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX).

* Experience with large-scale model training on GPUs and distributed systems.

* Strong work ethic with the ability to perform tasks independently.

* Proficient in analysis, presentation, and documentation of scientific data and scientific reports.

* Effective communicator with excellent interpersonal skills.

* Strong project management and organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask.

***Additional Preferred Qualifications:***

* Experience with genomics (single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq) or imaging datasets.

* Experience with cross-domain representation learning or other multimodal learning approaches.

* Track record of applying deep learning frameworks to scientific questions, as shown by publications in high impact journals or machine learning conferences.
